Subject: Initial DPA / Order Form redlines - ClientCorp / Redwood

Hannah —

Thanks for sending the draft MSA + Order Form. Our legal team reviewed the DPA and flagged a few items that need to be resolved before we can proceed to signature:

- SCCs: We need to see an express mapping to the EU SCCs (2021) and confirmation of which clauses Redwood wants to adapt via the Transfer Impact Addendum.

- TIA: Given our data flows (and a UK subsidiary), ClientCorp requires a short Transfer Impact Addendum addressing onward transfers to third-country subprocessors.

Can you let us know if Redwood can accept the SCCs with the usual limited modifications and provide a proposed table of subprocessors? Were hoping to complete legal review by next Friday (2026-02-12).

Attached: ClientCorp_DPA_marked.pdf (redlines)

Best,
Paul

- We can accept the EU 2021 SCCs in principle, but ClientCorp requires explicit language that Redwood will notify in-scope data exporters before onboarding new subprocessors that may involve transfers outside the EEA/UK.
